def paint(n: int, ops: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
    size = 1
    while size < len(ops):
        size <<= 1

    colours = [0] * (2 * size)
    has_erase = bytearray(2 * size)

    events = []
    for i, op in enumerate(ops):
        value = op[3] if op[0] == 1 else -1
        events.append((op[1], i, value))
        events.append((op[2] + 1, i, 0))
    events.sort()

    counts = {}
    previous = events[0][0]

    for position, index, value in events:
        if position != previous:
            colour = colours[1]
            if colour:
                counts[colour] = counts.get(colour, 0) + position - previous
            previous = position

        node = size + index
        colours[node] = value if value > 0 else 0
        has_erase[node] = value == -1
        node >>= 1

        while node:
            left = node << 1
            right = left | 1

            erased = has_erase[left] | has_erase[right]
            colour = colours[right]
            if not has_erase[right] and colours[left] > colour:
                colour = colours[left]

            if colours[node] == colour and has_erase[node] == erased:
                break

            colours[node] = colour
            has_erase[node] = erased
            node >>= 1

    return [[colour, counts[colour]] for colour in sorted(counts)]
